systems.system: Balcão Único de Atendimento ao Público (BUAP)
systems.tiers: service network in 164 municipalities, 518 communes and 44 urban districts; collecting identity-card data there is under way with technological shortcomings stated

systems.system: Postos de Identificação / Centro de Produção do Bilhete de Identidade (CPBI)
systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos
systems.tiers: about 364 identification posts nationally and abroad, some offline; printing centralised in Luanda

systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos
systems.tiers: one of five civil registration modes; more than 300 civil registry services with no centralised database

systems.system: Base de Dados de Cidadãos Maiores (BDCM)

note: A plan for identity-card issuance through the justice ministry's posts and the territorial administration ministry's BUAP counters; it states telecommunications instability and missing municipal and communal infrastructure in general terms but nothing about the connection of municipal administrations' own offices.
